title: P2 Inspector: improve product unit coverage and sparse package tests
body: Separate product test work. Increase whole-source local unit coverage from the evidence-backed baseline, prioritize sparse packages from coverage-by-package.json and test_coherence, and disposition existing TODOs through the product workflow. Retain all existing assertions, timeouts, native 80/50 coverage thresholds and original package coverage gates. Do not claim integration/E2E or RC coverage from the local-unit report. Respect the separate unapproved P4 planning boundary. Evidence: work/rounds/R-0036/reports/evaluation-e9e45a4a/evaluation-register.json; frozen candidate e9e45a4a6cbed5cfd394c716c79a55b1aca386b8.
